# RockshinOps

> Free, MIT-licensed desktop system monitor for macOS, Windows and Linux.

RockshinOps reads native CPU, memory, disk, network, process and connection data. It provides persistent menu bar metrics, disk-space analysis and reviewed cleanup. History stays in memory for the current session; no cloud account is required. Menu-bar icon management and app-uninstall review are macOS features. Hardware telemetry and desktop acceptance vary by platform; see the product pages for limits.

## Product

- [English product facts and downloads](https://rickyshin93.github.io/RockshinOps/index.md): Features, installation notes, platform limits and FAQs, generated from the visible website.
